text:
Alex Chen: quick heads-up — on the KB landing page ` /docs/guide/overview ` the nav link under "Getting started" -> "Dedicated" resolves to a 404 right now.
Maria Lopez: thanks for catching this. can you share the broken href? i can open a tiny PR unless it's owned by product docs.
Alex Chen: link is https://docs.redwood.dev/docs/dedicated (404). i did a quick grep; looks like the frontmatter slug changed in a recent rename.
Jordan Park: pinging @docs-owners ? we should avoid changing redirects without a shortlink. who owns the Dedicated guide atm?
Kevin Singh: if it's purely a nav frontmatter fix i'm happy to review/merge. otherwise we should route to product for content verification.
Alex Chen: i opened a draft PR with the minimal fix — updating `slug` in `docs/guide/overview.md` and adding a redirect from the old path. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1427
DocsBot: PR opened by Alex Chen — 1 file changed, CI started. Check required reviewers: docs-editors.
Maria Lopez: nice. small sed i used locally to find occurrences: ```bash
rg "docs/dedicated|/docs/dedicated" -n || true
sed -n '1,120p' docs/guide/overview.md
``` should be safe to include in PR description.
Jordan Park: added a note to the PR requesting the translation owners check for localized slugs — `i18n-team` might need to sync.
Kevin Singh: glanced at the diff — editorial only. i'll request review from `docs-editors` and merge once CI green. :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: thanks — can someone also add a tiny test or a check for orphan nav links? i can follow up in a separate PR.
Maria Lopez: +1. follow-up issue sounds good: quick script to validate sidebar links during CI.
Jordan Park: filed issue #389: "ci: sidebar link smoke test" and linked the PR.
Kevin Singh: merging once green. thanks everyone.
